title: MCP Tools, Resources & Prompt Templates
description: Expose read-only resources, URI schemes, dynamic subscriptions, and parameterized prompt templates via MCP in .NET.

data.text: Resources and Prompts: Beyond Just Tool Calling

While Tools in MCP are active functions that perform computations or mutations, Resources and Prompts provide passive context and structured guidance. Resources expose data—such as live database tables, log files, configuration documents, and memory stores—using standard URI patterns. Prompts expose pre-engineered, tested prompt templates that client applications and human operators can invoke with arguments.

rows: Live application settings and feature flags
Table schema, column types, and foreign key relationships
Giving agent accurate schema context before SQL generation
Correlated log streams for a specific error

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Resources provide read-only context attachments via standardized URI schemes
Prompts expose reusable, parameterized enterprise prompt templates
Use MIME types (application/json, text/markdown, application/sql) to inform clients of content format
Clients can subscribe to resource URIs to receive real-time notifications when files or databases update
Combining Tools, Resources, and Prompts creates a comprehensive, self-documenting AI integration boundary
data.takeaway: MCP is more than tool calling. Exposing enterprise schemas and documents as Resources and operational playbooks as Prompts provides AI agents with instant, structured context.
